title: CWP/12126/2013 of UNION OF INDIA & ORS Vs CENTRAL ADMINISTRATIVE TRIBUNAL & ORS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT FOR, THE STATES OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH. CWP No. 12126 of 2013. [O&M] Date of Decision:30" July, 2013. Union of India & Ors. Petitioners through Mr. P.C.Goyal, Advocate Versus Central Administrative Tribunal & Ors. Respondents through Mr. Rajesh Bhardwaj, Advocate, for respondent No. 2. CORAM:HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURYA KANT HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURINDER GUPTA

1. Whether Reporters of local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?

2. To be referred to the Reporters or not?

3. Whether the judgment should be reported in the Digest? SURYA KANT, J. [ORAL] For orders, see CWP No. 9033 of 2013 [Union of India & Ors. Vs. Central Administrative Tribunal & Anr.] decided vide our separate order of even date. ( SURYA KANT ) JUDGE July 30, 2013. ( SURINDER GUPTA ) dinesh JUDGE Iam the author of this document Hihg Court Chandigarh
